At tag 1.3.0 (5f8610c386e13de1d80d36efa961e1486a1d2d01) Request._get_form accepts max_fields/max_part_size and forwards them to MultiPartParser, but constructs FormParser(self.headers, self.stream()) with neither limit for application/x-www-form-urlencoded. FormParser.parse then synchronously parser.write()s each chunk, extends field_name/field_value with no size check, and items.append()s every FIELD_END with no count check. Source-to-sink is attacker urlencoded body -> Request.form/_get_form -> FormParser.parse -> unbounded CPU/memory.
